title: AgentContract
description: Machine-readable contract that defines the scope, requirements, and acceptance criteria for a single agent-implemented feature. The approved contract is the source of truth for implementation scope.

feature_id.description: Unique slug identifying this feature. Lowercase, digits, single dashes only. Matches the plan and approval token filenames.

objective.description: One-sentence description of what this feature achieves from the user's perspective.

requirements.description: Numbered list of concrete, testable requirements. Each requirement must be objectively verifiable.

description.description: Full requirement text. Must be specific enough that an implementer cannot misinterpret it.

priority.description: MoSCoW priority: must (required for acceptance), should (expected), could (nice-to-have).

non_requirements.description: Explicit list of things this feature does NOT include. Prevents scope creep.

allowed_paths.description: File paths (relative to repository root) the implementer is permitted to create or modify. Glob patterns are supported. Any file not listed here is implicitly forbidden.

forbidden_paths.description: File paths (relative to repository root) that must never be touched by this implementation. Listed explicitly for clarity even if they would be excluded by allowed_paths.

expected_files.description: Categorised list of files expected to change as a result of this implementation.

created.description: New files that will be created.

modified.description: Existing files that will be modified.

deleted.description: Existing files that will be deleted. Requires explicit justification.

dependencies.description: npm dependencies required by this feature. Any dependency not listed here must not be added.

justification.description: Why this dependency is necessary and why no existing dependency satisfies the need.

test_requirements.description: Tests that must exist and pass before this feature is considered complete.

description.description: What this test verifies, written as a full sentence.

security_requirements.description: Security properties that must hold for this feature. Each will be verified during the security review.

description.description: The security property that must hold.

acceptance_criteria.description: Objective, binary criteria. Each criterion must be answerable with pass/fail from observable behaviour — no subjective judgment.

description.description: The observable outcome and how to verify it.

automated.description: Whether this criterion can be verified by an automated test.

change_budget.description: Rough upper bounds on the size of this change. Used by scope-guard to flag excessive changes.

files_changed.description: Maximum number of files expected to change.

lines_added.description: Rough upper bound on lines added.

lines_removed.description: Rough upper bound on lines removed.

iteration_limit.description: Maximum number of Fixer+Verifier iterations before the loop is considered stuck and human intervention is required. Default and maximum is 10.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this contract. Only 'approved' unlocks implementation.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the human approved this contract. Null until /approve-plan is run.
